clips.title: The story
paras: Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar and quest giver stationed in the village of Dolanaar on Teldrassil. He guides newly arrived adventurers in understanding the nature of the great World Tree and tasks them with maintaining its sacred moonwells. Through his lessons, he reveals both the spiritual importance of Teldrassil and the growing burdens carried by the kaldorei.

Residing in the shaded settlement of Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage serves as an instructor to travelers leaving the sheltered bounds of Shadowglen. As young kaldorei venture into the wider boughs of Teldrassil, Corithras ensures they understand the history of their new home. He teaches that survival in this changing era requires vigilance and reverence for the natural order.

Much of Corithras's duty revolves around collecting moonwell water for the druids in Darnassus. He directs adventurers to collect pure waters from moonwells across Teldrassil in specially crafted phials for delivery to Fandral Staghelm. Through these trials, he monitors the health of the World Tree and seeks to maintain the delicate balance of the wilderness against creeping corruption.
